meta.note: This file deliberately avoids stating exact calendar dates for semester start/end, holidays, and vacations, since these change every academic year and stating a fake precise date would be more misleading than describing the realistic month-level pattern (consistent with how admissions_parul_details.json already handles 'important_dates_pattern'). Cross-references the semester structure and exam months already established in academic_details_parul.json rather than restating them differently. None of this should be treated as the confirmed current-year calendar — students should check the official academic calendar published each year via the ERP portal.

semester_start_and_end_dates.cross_reference: The semester structure itself (Odd Semester: July-December, Even Semester: January-June) is already documented in academic_details_parul.json's 'general_academic_policies.semester_and_credit_system'.

typical_pattern.odd_semester: Typically begins in the last week of July or first week of August, and runs through classes until late November/early December, followed by the exam period.
typical_pattern.even_semester: Typically begins in the first or second week of January, and runs through classes until March/April, followed by the exam period.

semester_start_and_end_dates.disclaimer: Exact start/end dates for the current academic year are published on the official academic calendar via the student ERP portal and should be treated as authoritative over this general pattern.

regional_and_religious_festival_breaks: Navratri — a short break or reduced-schedule period is common given Gujarat's strong Navratri culture (typically September/October)
Diwali break — typically a 1-2 week break around the festival (October/November), often coinciding with the tail end of odd-semester classes before the exam period
holiday_list_and_festival_breaks.disclaimer: Exact dates shift each year based on the lunar/festival calendar; the current year's holiday list is published alongside the official academic calendar.

summer_and_winter_vacation_schedule.summer_vacation: The main extended break falls between the end of the even semester and the start of the next odd semester, typically spanning parts of May, June, and into July — this is also the period referenced for summer internships in internships_career_development_parul_details.json.
summer_and_winter_vacation_schedule.winter_break: A shorter winter break typically occurs around the Diwali festival period and/or between the end of odd-semester classes and the start of exams, rather than a separate extended winter vacation block.

exam_period_blocks.note: This describes the CALENDAR BLOCK during which exams occur, distinct from the exam pattern/weightage policy already documented in academic_details_parul.json's 'exam_pattern'.
exam_period_blocks.odd_semester_exam_block: Typically a 2-3 week block in November-December, following the exam months already documented in academic_details_parul.json.
exam_period_blocks.even_semester_exam_block: Typically a 2-3 week block in April-May.
exam_period_blocks.backlog_exam_block: A separate shorter exam block for backlog/supplementary exams occurs a few weeks after each regular exam period, consistent with the backlog policy timing already documented.

orientation_week_schedule.timing: Orientation typically takes place in the first week of the odd semester (late July/early August), coinciding with or shortly before the Freshers Fest event already documented in events_fests_cultural_calendar_parul_details.json.
orientation_week_schedule.typical_structure: A formal academic orientation component (faculty introductions, campus tour, ERP/ID card setup, overview of clubs and support services — already described in events_fests_cultural_calendar_parul_details.json) is generally held during the first few days, often followed by the more celebratory Freshers Fest welcome later in the same window.
